The audit covered the home feed, category pages (Weather, Economics, Championship Grids), navigation, and a mobile smoke test. I've compiled the findings into a detailed Markdown report and captured all the requested screenshots.

Key findings include:
- **Critical Navigation Failures**: The "Leagues" and "Excitement Index" footer links return 404 errors.
